en.headline: Second fire at Wong Tai Sin estate evening sees about 100 evacuated from Lung Wo House
en.dek: Police said the blaze in a unit was extinguished with no one taken to hospital, and believed it was related to cooking in the kitchen.
body: Police reported a fire in a unit at Lung Wo House in Wong Tai Sin Lower Estate on Sunday evening. Firefighters used one hose and a smoke-mask team to put out the blaze by about 6:45pm after it was reported around 6pm.
About 100 residents were evacuated for a time. Police said no one needed to be sent to hospital. Preliminary belief is that the fire was related to cooking in the kitchen.

The incident came hours after a separate fatal fire earlier the same day at Lung Kwong House in the same estate, where an 80-year-old woman was found dead. Authorities treated the two cases as distinct.

zh.headline: 黃大仙下邨龍和樓傍晚火警 約100人一度疏散無人送院
zh.dek: 警方指單位火警已救熄，初步相信與廚房煮食有關，無人需要送院。
body: 警方表示，周日傍晚黃大仙下邨龍和樓一個單位發生火警。消防到場後出動一條喉及一隊煙帽隊灌救，大約下午6時45分將火救熄。
事件中一度約100名住戶疏散。警方稱初步無人需要送院，並相信起火原因與廚房煮食有關。
同日早上，同邨龍光樓另一單位曾發生奪命火警，一名八旬獨居女子在單位內被發現死亡。當局將兩宗火警視為分開處理。
